messages.subject: Installation trouble
parts:
Hi there,

I've read all the release notes and tried downloading every version of Distance with no luck!

Every time I try running the d62setup.exe file I get the following error message in the "WinZip self-Extractor" window: 

Error 0 running command D62release1.EXE

I have windows 7 and R version 3.2 and am based out of the US. I've tried rebooting and turning all other programmes off.

Any help would be appreciated!

Rachel

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Installation trouble
parts:
Rachel:

We have seen this error previously.  It is related to installing Distance on a network and running foul of network administration policies.  This is the suggested remedy:

group policy won't let installs run from the user\username\appdata\local\temp folder so after getting the error I moved the D62Release.exe to another local folder and was able to install from there.

Let us know if this remedy succeeds for you.
